chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Ibn Muskan, from Mālik al-Juhanī, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the time of ẓuhr, and he said: “When the sun declines, then the time of the two prayers has entered.”

key_terms.زَالَتِ الشَّمْسُ: the sun declined from the meridian; the onset of noon prayer time
key_terms.وَقْتُ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ: the time of the two prayers, meaning ẓuhr and ʿaṣr
key_terms.وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ: the prescribed time of the noon salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr salat begin in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal beginning of the time for ẓuhr salat (prayer). It indicates that when the sun passes the zenith, the time for both ẓuhr and ʿaṣr begins, making it a foundational text in prayer timings.
